import MumfordLib.SingularCochains
import Mathlib.AlgebraicTopology.SimplicialSet.Subcomplex

/-!
# Integral cochains on unions of simplicial subcomplexes

Integral cochains are the duals of Mathlib's simplicial chains. Restriction to
a subcomplex commutes with the coboundary and is surjective in every degree.
Compatible cochains on two subcomplexes glue uniquely over their union.

This is the algebraic gluing step for singular small chains in the circle
calculation underlying Mumford, Chapter I, Section 1, p. 3. Identifying small
chains with all singular chains still requires the subdivision comparison.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
open scoped Simplicial

namespace Mumford.Analytic

/-- The integral dual of the simplicial chain group in degree `n`. -/
abbrev IntegralSimplicialCochain (K : SSet) (n : ℕ) :=
  (K.chainComplex (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).X n ⟶ ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ

variable {K L M : SSet} {n : ℕ}

/-- Evaluation of a cochain on the generator of a simplex. -/
def simplicialCochainEval (φ : IntegralSimplicialCochain K n)
    (σ : K.obj (op ⦋n⦌)) : ℤ :=
  (K.ιChainComplex σ ≫ φ).hom 1

/-- Values on the simplex generators determine an integral cochain. -/
@[ext]
theorem integralSimplicialCochain_ext {φ ψ : IntegralSimplicialCochain K n}
    (h : ∀ σ, simplicialCochainEval φ σ = simplicialCochainEval ψ σ) : φ = ψ := by
  apply SSet.chainComplex_hom_ext
  intro σ
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  exact LinearMap.ext_ring (h σ)

/-- Extend an integer-valued simplex function by linearity to chains. -/
def simplicialCochainOfFunction (f : K.obj (op ⦋n⦌) → ℤ) :
    IntegralSimplicialCochain K n :=
  Sigma.desc (fun σ => f σ • 𝟙 (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ))

@[simp]
theorem simplicialCochainOfFunction_eval (f : K.obj (op ⦋n⦌) → ℤ)
    (σ : K.obj (op ⦋n⦌)) :
    simplicialCochainEval (simplicialCochainOfFunction f) σ = f σ := by
  have h : K.ιChainComplex σ ≫ simplicialCochainOfFunction f =
      f σ • 𝟙 (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ) := Sigma.ι_desc _ _
  simp [simplicialCochainEval, h]

/-- Simplicial cochains specialize definitionally to the existing singular cochains. -/
theorem integralSimplicialCochain_toSSet (X : TopCat) (n : ℕ) :
    IntegralSimplicialCochain (TopCat.toSSet.obj X) n = IntegralSingularCochain X n := rfl

/-- The differential on integral simplicial cochains. -/
def simplicialCochainDifferential (K : SSet) (n : ℕ) :
    IntegralSimplicialCochain K n →ₗ[ℤ] IntegralSimplicialCochain K (n + 1) where
  toFun φ := (K.chainComplex (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).d (n + 1) n ≫ φ
  map_add' _ _ := by simp
  map_smul' _ _ := by simp

@[simp]
theorem simplicialCochainDifferential_squared (φ : IntegralSimplicialCochain K n) :
    simplicialCochainDifferential K (n + 1) (simplicialCochainDifferential K n φ) = 0 := by
  simp [simplicialCochainDifferential]

/-- Pullback is dual to the actual simplicial chain map. -/
def simplicialCochainPullback (f : K ⟶ L) (n : ℕ) :
    IntegralSimplicialCochain L n →ₗ[ℤ] IntegralSimplicialCochain K n where
  toFun φ := (SSet.chainComplexMap f (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).f n ≫ φ
  map_add' _ _ := by simp
  map_smul' _ _ := by simp

@[simp]
theorem simplicialCochainPullback_eval (f : K ⟶ L)
    (φ : IntegralSimplicialCochain L n) (σ : K.obj (op ⦋n⦌)) :
    simplicialCochainEval (simplicialCochainPullback f n φ) σ =
      simplicialCochainEval φ (f.app _ σ) := by
  simp [simplicialCochainEval, simplicialCochainPullback, ← Category.assoc]

@[simp]
theorem simplicialCochainPullback_comp (f : K ⟶ L) (g : L ⟶ M)
    (φ : IntegralSimplicialCochain M n) :
    simplicialCochainPullback (f ≫ g) n φ =
      simplicialCochainPullback f n (simplicialCochainPullback g n φ) := by
  simp [simplicialCochainPullback]

/-- Restriction is a cochain map. -/
theorem simplicialCochainPullback_differential (f : K ⟶ L)
    (φ : IntegralSimplicialCochain L n) :
    simplicialCochainPullback f (n + 1) (simplicialCochainDifferential L n φ) =
      simplicialCochainDifferential K n (simplicialCochainPullback f n φ) := by
  dsimp [simplicialCochainPullback, simplicialCochainDifferential]
  rw [← Category.assoc, HomologicalComplex.Hom.comm, Category.assoc]

/-- Extension by zero on the simplex basis makes restriction surjective.
The extension itself need not commute with the differential. -/
theorem simplicialCochainPullback_subcomplex_surjective (A : K.Subcomplex) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (simplicialCochainPullback A.ι n) := by
  classical
  intro φ
  refine ⟨simplicialCochainOfFunction (fun σ =>
    if h : σ ∈ A.obj (op ⦋n⦌) then simplicialCochainEval φ ⟨σ, h⟩ else 0), ?_⟩
  apply integralSimplicialCochain_ext
  intro σ
  simp [σ.property]

/-- A cochain on a union is determined by its two restrictions. -/
theorem simplicialCochain_union_ext (A B : K.Subcomplex)
    {φ ψ : IntegralSimplicialCochain (A ⊔ B : K.Subcomplex) n}
    (hA : simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_left) n φ =
      simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_left : (A : SSet) ⟶ _) n ψ)
    (hB : simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_right) n φ =
      simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_right : (B : SSet) ⟶ _) n ψ) :
    φ = ψ := by
  apply integralSimplicialCochain_ext
  rintro ⟨σ, hσ⟩
  rcases hσ with hσ | hσ
  · simpa using congrArg
      (fun θ : IntegralSimplicialCochain A n => simplicialCochainEval θ ⟨σ, hσ⟩) hA
  · simpa using congrArg
      (fun θ : IntegralSimplicialCochain B n => simplicialCochainEval θ ⟨σ, hσ⟩) hB

/-- Compatible cochains on two subcomplexes extend to their union. -/
theorem simplicialCochain_exists_gluing (A B : K.Subcomplex)
    (φ : IntegralSimplicialCochain A n) (ψ : IntegralSimplicialCochain B n)
    (h : simplicialCochainPullback
        (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE inf_le_left : ((A ⊓ B : K.Subcomplex) : SSet) ⟶ A) n φ =
      simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE inf_le_right) n ψ) :
    ∃ θ : IntegralSimplicialCochain (A ⊔ B : K.Subcomplex) n,
      simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_left) n θ = φ ∧
      simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_right) n θ = ψ := by
  classical
  refine ⟨simplicialCochainOfFunction (fun σ =>
    if hA : σ.val ∈ A.obj (op ⦋n⦌) then simplicialCochainEval φ ⟨σ.val, hA⟩
    else simplicialCochainEval ψ ⟨σ.val, σ.property.resolve_left hA⟩), ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply integralSimplicialCochain_ext
    intro σ
    simp [σ.property]
  · apply integralSimplicialCochain_ext
    intro σ
    rw [simplicialCochainPullback_eval, simplicialCochainOfFunction_eval]
    by_cases hA : σ.val ∈ A.obj (op ⦋n⦌)
    · simp only [SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE_app_val, dif_pos hA]
      simpa using congrArg (fun η : IntegralSimplicialCochain (A ⊓ B : K.Subcomplex) n =>
        simplicialCochainEval η ⟨σ.val, hA, σ.property⟩) h
    · simp [hA]

/-- Simultaneous restriction to the two members of a union. -/
def simplicialCochainUnionRestriction (A B : K.Subcomplex) (n : ℕ) :
    IntegralSimplicialCochain (A ⊔ B : K.Subcomplex) n →ₗ[ℤ]
      IntegralSimplicialCochain A n × IntegralSimplicialCochain B n :=
  (simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_left) n).prod
    (simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_right) n)

/-- The difference of the two restrictions to the intersection. -/
def simplicialCochainIntersectionDifference (A B : K.Subcomplex) (n : ℕ) :
    (IntegralSimplicialCochain A n × IntegralSimplicialCochain B n) →ₗ[ℤ]
      IntegralSimplicialCochain (A ⊓ B : K.Subcomplex) n :=
  (simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE inf_le_left) n).comp
      (LinearMap.fst ℤ _ _) -
    (simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE inf_le_right) n).comp
      (LinearMap.snd ℤ _ _)

/-- The first arrow of the two-subcomplex cochain sequence is injective. -/
theorem simplicialCochainUnionRestriction_injective (A B : K.Subcomplex) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (simplicialCochainUnionRestriction A B n) := by
  intro φ ψ h
  exact simplicialCochain_union_ext A B (congrArg Prod.fst h) (congrArg Prod.snd h)

@[simp]
theorem simplicialCochainIntersectionDifference_restriction (A B : K.Subcomplex)
    (φ : IntegralSimplicialCochain (A ⊔ B : K.Subcomplex) n) :
    simplicialCochainIntersectionDifference A B n (simplicialCochainUnionRestriction A B n φ) =
      0 := by
  change simplicialCochainPullback _ n (simplicialCochainPullback _ n φ) -
    simplicialCochainPullback _ n (simplicialCochainPullback _ n φ) = 0
  rw [← simplicialCochainPullback_comp, ← simplicialCochainPullback_comp]
  exact sub_self _

/-- The two-subcomplex cochain sequence is exact at the pair of cochains. -/
theorem simplicialCochain_union_range_eq_ker (A B : K.Subcomplex) (n : ℕ) :
    LinearMap.range (simplicialCochainUnionRestriction A B n) =
      LinearMap.ker (simplicialCochainIntersectionDifference A B n) := by
  ext p
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨φ, rfl⟩
    exact simplicialCochainIntersectionDifference_restriction A B φ
  · intro h
    have hp : simplicialCochainPullback
        (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE inf_le_left : ((A ⊓ B : K.Subcomplex) : SSet) ⟶ A) n p.1 =
        simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE inf_le_right) n p.2 :=
      sub_eq_zero.mp h
    obtain ⟨θ, hA, hB⟩ := simplicialCochain_exists_gluing A B p.1 p.2 hp
    exact ⟨θ, Prod.ext hA hB⟩

/-- Restricting a cochain from a larger subcomplex is surjective in every degree. -/
theorem simplicialCochainPullback_homOfLE_surjective {A B : K.Subcomplex} (h : A ≤ B)
    (n : ℕ) : Function.Surjective
      (simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE h) n) := by
  intro φ
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := simplicialCochainPullback_subcomplex_surjective A n φ
  refine ⟨simplicialCochainPullback B.ι n ψ, ?_⟩
  rwa [← simplicialCochainPullback_comp]

/-- The final arrow of the two-subcomplex cochain sequence is surjective. -/
theorem simplicialCochainIntersectionDifference_surjective (A B : K.Subcomplex) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (simplicialCochainIntersectionDifference A B n) := by
  intro φ
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := simplicialCochainPullback_homOfLE_surjective
    (inf_le_left : A ⊓ B ≤ A) n φ
  refine ⟨(ψ, 0), ?_⟩
  change simplicialCochainPullback _ n ψ - simplicialCochainPullback _ n 0 = φ
  rw [hψ, map_zero, sub_zero]

/-- Local primitives glue after correcting their difference by an overlap primitive. -/
theorem simplicialCochain_exists_primitive_of_local (A B : K.Subcomplex)
    (φ : IntegralSimplicialCochain (A ⊔ B : K.Subcomplex) (n + 2))
    (α : IntegralSimplicialCochain A (n + 1))
    (β : IntegralSimplicialCochain B (n + 1))
    (hA : simplicialCochainDifferential A (n + 1) α =
      simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_left) (n + 2) φ)
    (hB : simplicialCochainDifferential B (n + 1) β =
      simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_right) (n + 2) φ)
    (γ : IntegralSimplicialCochain (A ⊓ B : K.Subcomplex) n)
    (hγ : simplicialCochainDifferential (A ⊓ B : K.Subcomplex) n γ =
      simplicialCochainIntersectionDifference A B (n + 1) (α, β)) :
    ∃ θ : IntegralSimplicialCochain (A ⊔ B : K.Subcomplex) (n + 1),
      simplicialCochainDifferential (A ⊔ B : K.Subcomplex) (n + 1) θ = φ := by
  obtain ⟨η, hη⟩ := simplicialCochainPullback_homOfLE_surjective
    (inf_le_left : A ⊓ B ≤ A) n γ
  have hc : simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE inf_le_left)
        (n + 1) (α - simplicialCochainDifferential A n η) =
      simplicialCochainPullback
        (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE inf_le_right : ((A ⊓ B : K.Subcomplex) : SSet) ⟶ B)
        (n + 1) β := by
    rw [map_sub, simplicialCochainPullback_differential, hη, hγ]
    dsimp [simplicialCochainIntersectionDifference]
    abel
  obtain ⟨θ, hθA, hθB⟩ := simplicialCochain_exists_gluing A B
    (α - simplicialCochainDifferential A n η) β hc
  refine ⟨θ, simplicialCochain_union_ext A B ?_ ?_⟩
  · rw [simplicialCochainPullback_differential, hθA, map_sub,
      simplicialCochainDifferential_squared, sub_zero, hA]
  · rw [simplicialCochainPullback_differential, hθB, hB]

/-- Vanishing on two subcomplexes and their overlap implies vanishing on the union
one degree higher. The hypotheses are explicit local primitive producers. -/
theorem simplicialCochain_union_exists_primitive (A B : K.Subcomplex) (n : ℕ)
    (hA : ∀ α : IntegralSimplicialCochain A (n + 2),
      simplicialCochainDifferential A (n + 2) α = 0 →
      ∃ β, simplicialCochainDifferential A (n + 1) β = α)
    (hB : ∀ α : IntegralSimplicialCochain B (n + 2),
      simplicialCochainDifferential B (n + 2) α = 0 →
      ∃ β, simplicialCochainDifferential B (n + 1) β = α)
    (hAB : ∀ α : IntegralSimplicialCochain (A ⊓ B : K.Subcomplex) (n + 1),
      simplicialCochainDifferential (A ⊓ B : K.Subcomplex) (n + 1) α = 0 →
      ∃ β, simplicialCochainDifferential (A ⊓ B : K.Subcomplex) n β = α)
    (φ : IntegralSimplicialCochain (A ⊔ B : K.Subcomplex) (n + 2))
    (hφ : simplicialCochainDifferential (A ⊔ B : K.Subcomplex) (n + 2) φ = 0) :
    ∃ θ, simplicialCochainDifferential (A ⊔ B : K.Subcomplex) (n + 1) θ = φ := by
  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := hA (simplicialCochainPullback
    (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_left) (n + 2) φ) (by
      rw [← simplicialCochainPullback_differential, hφ, map_zero])
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := hB (simplicialCochainPullback
    (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_right) (n + 2) φ) (by
      rw [← simplicialCochainPullback_differential, hφ, map_zero])
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := hAB (simplicialCochainIntersectionDifference A B (n + 1) (α, β)) (by
    dsimp only [simplicialCochainIntersectionDifference, LinearMap.sub_apply,
      LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.fst_apply, LinearMap.snd_apply]
    rw [map_sub, ← simplicialCochainPullback_differential,
      ← simplicialCochainPullback_differential, hα, hβ,
      ← simplicialCochainPullback_comp, ← simplicialCochainPullback_comp]
    exact sub_self _)
  exact simplicialCochain_exists_primitive_of_local A B φ α β hα hβ γ hγ

end Mumford.Analytic
